reason: My evenings are already sorted: same bar, same people, plans made on WhatsApp. I might download it out of curiosity, but downloading is not going, and I am not buying a concert ticket through an app I opened once.
objection: I have seen this before with the TEA app — it launches, there are three events on it, nobody I know is on it, and it dies. An empty feed of strangers' yoga sessions does not replace my crew.
would_change_my_mind: If my actual friends were on it and I could see people I know marked as going to something — or if the WhatsApp group I already use started sharing links from it.
